  "claims": [],
  "behavior_violation": true,
  "severity": 5,
  "reason": "The assistant provides inaccurate and generalized information that contradicts the reference. Specifically, it incorrectly states that contributions for non-working persons (e.g., students, early retirees) start when they cease working or reach retirement age, whereas the reference specifies that non-employed persons pay from 1 January after their 20th birthday until reference age and must register themselves with a compensation office. The assistant also omits the requirement for non-working spouses to be covered only if the working spouse pays at least twice the minimum contribution.",
  "evidence": "Per le persone che non esercitano un'attività lucrativa, come studenti o pensionati anticipati, i contributi AVS/AI/IPG devono essere pagati a partire dal momento in cui cessano l'attività lucrativa o raggiungono l'età pensionabile."
}
